functions.name: GetMovementComponent
functions.docs: Return our PawnMovementComponent, if we have one. By default, returns the first PawnMovementComponent found. Native classes that create their own movement component should override this method for more efficiency.

functions.name: PawnMakeNoise
functions.signature: PawnMakeNoise(Target, Loudness, Noise Location, Use Noise Maker Location, Noise Maker)

functions.name: GetLocalViewingPlayerController
functions.docs: Returns local Player Controller viewing this pawn, whether it is controlling or spectating

functions.name: GetMovementBaseActor
functions.docs: Gets the owning actor of the Movement Base Component on which the pawn is standing.

functions.name: IsControlled
functions.docs: See if this actor is currently being controlled

functions.name: IsPawnControlled
functions.docs: Check if this actor is currently being controlled at all (the actor has a valid Controller, which will be false for remote clients)

functions.name: GetController
functions.docs: Returns controller for this actor.

functions.name: GetControlRotation
functions.docs: Get the rotation of the Controller, often the 'view' rotation of this Pawn.

functions.name: OnRep_Controller
functions.docs: Called when Controller is replicated

functions.name: OnRep_PlayerState
functions.docs: PlayerState Replication Notification Callback

functions.name: SetCanAffectNavigationGeneration
functions.docs:
Use SetCanAffectNavigationGeneration to change this value at runtime.
Note that calling this function at runtime will result in any navigation change only if runtime navigation generation is enabled.

functions.name: GetNavAgentLocation
functions.docs: Basically retrieved pawn's location on navmesh

functions.name: ReceivePossessed
functions.docs: Event called when the Pawn is possessed by a Controller. Only called on the server (or in standalone)

functions.name: ReceiveUnpossessed
functions.docs: Event called when the Pawn is no longer possessed by a Controller. Only called on the server (or in standalone)

functions.name: ReceiveControllerChanged
functions.docs: Event called after a pawn's controller has changed, on the server and owning client. This will happen at the same time as the delegate on GameInstance

functions.name: ReceiveRestarted
functions.docs: Event called after a pawn has been restarted, usually by a possession change. This is called on the server for all pawns and the owning client for player pawns

functions.name: IsLocallyControlled
functions.docs: Returns true if controlled by a local (not network) Controller.

functions.name: GetPlatformUserId
functions.docs:
Returns the Platform User ID of the PlayerController that is controlling this character.
Returns an invalid Platform User ID if this character is not controlled by a local player.

functions.name: IsPlayerControlled
functions.docs: Returns true if controlled by a human player (possessed by a PlayerController).	This returns true for players controlled by remote clients

functions.name: IsBotControlled
functions.docs: Returns true if controlled by a bot.

functions.name: GetBaseAimRotation
functions.docs:
Return the aim rotation for the Pawn.
If we have a controller, by default we aim at the player's 'eyes' direction
that is by default the Pawn rotation for AI, and camera (crosshair) rotation for human players.

functions.name: DetachFromControllerPendingDestroy
functions.docs: Call this function to detach safely pawn from its controller, knowing that we will be destroyed soon.

functions.name: SpawnDefaultController
functions.docs: Spawn default controller for this Pawn, and get possessed by it.

functions.name: AddMovementInput
functions.signature: AddMovementInput(Target, World Direction, Scale Value, Force)
functions.docs: No bindings by default.

functions.name: GetPendingMovementInputVector
GetLastMovementInputVector
ConsumeMovementInputVector
functions.docs:
Returns the pending input vector and resets it to zero.
This should be used during a movement update (by the Pawn or PawnMovementComponent) to prevent accumulation of control input between frames.
Copies the pending input vector to the saved input vector (GetLastMovementInputVector()).
@return The pending input vector.

functions.name: AddControllerPitchInput
AddControllerYawInput
AddControllerRollInput
IsMoveInputIgnored
functions.docs: Helper to see if move input is ignored. If our controller is a PlayerController, checks Controller->IsMoveInputIgnored().
